visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and a white hairpin sits on a white stool. Behind her, a man in a white t-shirt and black pants holds a long, black corrugated tube attached to a black bonnet on her head. The room has dark wood flooring and doors. (2) The woman stands in front of a white shelf holding a red hair dryer. She holds up a retail package for a 'Bonnet Dryer Attachment'. She smiles and gestures towards the camera. (3) She demonstrates a red hair dryer placed in a white wall-mounted holder, pointing at it while talking. (4) The woman is now crouching, putting the black bonnet onto her head. The man stands behind her helping to straighten the long tube connected to a hair dryer off-camera. (5) She sits again, now wearing a black long-sleeve shirt, holding a large tablet showing a digital stopwatch at 00:00.00. (6) A transition shows water spraying from a showerhead. (7) The woman appears back on the stool with wet hair, putting the bonnet back on. She then shows the tablet timer at 10:00.36. (8) She removes the bonnet to show her hair is still visibly wet and damp, holding a clump of it close to the lens. (9) She holds the black bonnet up, laughing and talking to the camera with a resigned expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-intensity whirring sound of a hair dryer dominates. A female voice shouts excitedly, '欸它有風欸!!!' (Hey, it has wind!). (2) Upbeat, major-key pop BGM swells. Female voice shifts to a professional, friendly narrative tone. Plastic rustling sounds as she handles the product box. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX marks a transition. The female voice speed increases (pitch-shifted) as she summarizes. (4) A loud cinematic 'impact' or crash SFX occurs. The female voice gasps and says 'Holy crap' in a surprised, low-arousal tone. (5) Whirring dryer sound returns as she tests the wind again. (6) Sound of rushing water for two seconds. (7) A 'ding' bell SFX triggers a shift to soft piano music. (8) BGM returns to upbeat pop. Female voice reviews results with a laughing, slightly teasing tone. (9) A comedic 'fail' sound effect or buzzer occurs as she declares 'Challenge Failed'.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Unboxing -> Demonstration -> Experiment -> Result -> Verdict
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously test and review a niche hair-drying gadget (the bonnet dryer attachment) to see if it actually works for drying long hair as a 'lazy person's solution'.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator concludes that the product is inefficient and fails the challenge, which is inconsistent with a paid endorsement.
